summary: Avidia Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 26, 2026, solely to announce the date and details of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, scheduled for September 15, 2026, with a record date of July 24, 2026. The filing contains Items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits) and includes no mention of any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, management change, or strategic review. This is a routine scheduling notice and does not qualify as a special situation.
